commonConstraints: Use the supplied design as visual inspiration only. Warm welcoming Jeju travel editorial style, natural coral-peach, cream, sea turquoise and canola yellow, clean restrained composition, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no interface or smartphone frame. Assets are brand/editorial or explicitly fictional demo scenes; never pass generated scenes off as photographs of a named real business. Export every requested item separately.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a premium mobile travel-app hero, portrait 2:3. A Korean family with a parent, a young child in a straw hat, a healthy older grandmother and a friendly golden retriever on a leash enjoying a peaceful Jeju coast, viewed from behind. They sit together on a low basalt stone bench, surrounded by sparse yellow canola flowers. A recognizable broad Jeju volcanic coastal silhouette beyond the calm sea in warm golden-hour light. Keep all people and dog in the lower 40 percent. The upper half is open peach and apricot sky with subtle soft clouds, providing excellent uncluttered space for dark app headings to be added later. Respectful, joyful, inclusive, realistic proportions and hands, natural photographic texture, sophisticated editorial travel photography, not a commercial for an actual location. No text, UI, logo, watermark or phone.
